# iOS App Factory Rules

## Authority

This AGENTS.md is the canonical instruction authority for every coding client.
Generated client files may point here but cannot weaken it.

## Principles

- Preserve user changes.
- Bind completion to immutable evidence.

## Enforced rules

- `rule.scope.preserve`: Only change declared paths. (enforced by `broker`; check `policy.changed-paths`)
- `rule.quality.coherence`: One design generation must cover every public route. (enforced by `trusted-check`; check `quality.ui-coherence`)

## Protected surfaces

- `quality/baselines` — baseline; changes require `quality.baseline-change`.

## Completion

Agent prose is never proof of completion. The broker, trusted checks, independent review, and approval records are authoritative.

## Machine-checkable declarations

The `factory-rule:` lines below are parsed by the App Factory project scanner and broker.
Client adapters bind to this file by `authority.import` and `authority.digest`.

factory-rule: authority.version=1
factory-rule: policy.id=factory.ios-policy
factory-rule: policy.version=1
factory-rule: policy.digest=sha256:700c6bc7490de34bcf31744cf91f086283992537a254a176b62d7c061b541d86
factory-rule: rule.scope.preserve.enforcement=broker
factory-rule: rule.scope.preserve.check=policy.changed-paths
factory-rule: rule.quality.coherence.enforcement=trusted-check
factory-rule: rule.quality.coherence.check=quality.ui-coherence
